title: University of Tehran
standfirst: Iran's first university, inaugurated on 4 February 1935 under a law introduced in 1934.

body.text: A law establishing the university was introduced in the Majlis on 13 March 1934; the university was inaugurated on 4 February 1935[@iranica-higher-education].
The Library of Congress gives 1935 for its establishment as the first European-style university[@loc15].
